minutes.headline: Conservation Commission approved the 42 Pearl Street wall notice of intent, conditioned on closing out the first order.
minutes.summary: The commission held hearings on retaining wall replacement at 42 Pearl Street, a retroactive tree removal at 50 Pine Grove Road, and a septic and wall project at 105 Horizon Island Road. Earth Day plans, encroachment issues and associate member recruitment were discussed.

what_happened.line: The Conservation Commission approved a notice of intent for the 42 Pearl Street retaining and shoreline walls, on the condition that the earlier order is closed out with a certificate of compliance.
The commission approved a notice of intent for the septic and wall project at 105 Horizon Island Road, with standard conditions.
It issued a negative determination for retroactive tree removal at 50 Pine Grove Road, and approved an administrative determination for tree removal at 437 Townsend Harbor Road.
The commission issued a certificate of compliance for a 1989 order at 1147 Mass Ave / 5 Chestnut Street.
The administrator scheduled a meeting with the town attorney about two remaining encroachments, and the chair is to ask for an associate member to be advertised.

why_it_matters: These are permit decisions for work near wetlands and shorelines, so they set what neighbors of these properties may see built and which conditions the work must meet.
The encroachment talks with the town attorney and the search for an associate member bear on how the commission enforces its orders and whether it can reach a quorum.
watch_next: The commission is likely to take up the certificate of compliance for the original 42 Pearl Street order at its next meeting, once the current work is complete and stabilized.
The town attorney meeting on the encroachments at 950 Chase Road and 110 Pleasant Street Lot 2.
